protocol_or_search_strategy: Targeted preliminary source identification and extraction. This is not a completed systematic review. Search performed 2026-11-13; full-text appraisal, reproducible multi-database search and duplicate screening remain pending.
inclusion_criteria: Human clinical evidence or official regulator/health-agency assessments relevant to the ingredient and stated outcome.
Systematic reviews, meta-analyses, clinical practice guidelines and authoritative safety documents.
exclusion_criteria: Animal or in-vitro findings as sole basis for clinical claims.
Marketing pages and manufacturer promotional material.
Extrapolation across unrelated indications, formulations or populations.
risk_of_bias_tool: Not yet applied; use RoB 2 for randomized trials and AMSTAR 2 for systematic reviews where appropriate.
applicability: Ingredient-specific scope only; no individual dose or recommendation approved.
conflicts_or_uncertainties: This record documents source discovery, not evidence certainty.
Source currency and all primary studies must be checked before approval.
Commercial formulation and jurisdiction may alter applicability.
